name: mhk
description: Minimal Harness Kit for Codex: verified project rules, shared team memory, and native permission proposals.

interface.shortDescription: Codex repository rules and shared team memory
interface.longDescription: Generate an indexed Codex harness from verified Claude mhk rules or a fresh scan, verify and add one supplied project rule, or set up the shared team memory that Codex offers to fill as you work. A read-only doctor reports what is set up, broken, or stale. Native permission proposals are reviewed separately.
defaultPrompt: Use $mhk-rules to generate Codex guidance for this repository.
